description: A state's statewide equivalency audit, from the latest finished run (or the run named): schools audited and failed, published rules read, counts and percent per class, the out-of-date total (held_retired + likely_renumbered + not_held) with its percent of all rules, the schools sorted by out-of-date rules, highest first and paged (default 20, at most 100; rules read, out-of-date count and percent, checklists affected), the top 20 findings statewide by checklists affected, and the run's publish, code build and dates so two runs can be compared. Read-only. Recognition is the school's act; findings are for the school to confirm. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list.

limit.description: Optional: the schools listed (default 20, at most 100)

run_id.description: Optional: one run; default the latest finished run for the state
